property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later timestamp than the previous call, whenever block.number % 15 == 0 the reference contract forwards the entire contract balance to msg.sender (leaving address(c).balance == 0) but the mutant that sends only half may leave a non-zero balance, so the invariant is: after such a fallback call at a block where block.number % 15 == 0, address(c).balance == 0 (reference holds for all inputs; mutant breaks for some inputs).
change_summary: Replace the transfer call with sending only half the contract balance, changing post-call balances and thus observable behavior.
